title: Winter pruning, storm prep and tree permits

seo.title: Winter Pruning, Storm Prep & Tree Permits | Victoria
seo.description: When to prune in Greater Victoria's mild winters, how to ready trees and hedges for wind storms, and how to check your municipality's tree bylaw.

summary: Dormant pruning, storm preparation and how to check whether your tree work needs a permit.

body.p: Winters here are mild and wet, with windstorms that bring down limbs and sometimes whole trees. Winter is also a good time to prune many trees and shrubs while they are dormant and their structure is easy to see.

list: Fruit trees such as apples and pears.
Many deciduous shade trees and shrubs, for structure and clearance.
Leave spring-flowering shrubs until after they bloom.
Look for dead branches, cracks, or limbs rubbing against the house or wires.
Check for leaning trees, lifting soil or mushrooms at the base, which can be signs of root problems.
Keep branches clear of roofs and gutters.
Stay well away from any tree touching power lines and call your utility.

body.p: Most municipalities in Greater Victoria have their own tree rules. Many protect native species like Garry oak, arbutus, Pacific dogwood and Pacific yew at small sizes, and some cover trees on steep slopes, near water or with nests. Some also limit how much you can prune, and topping is prohibited in places such as North Saanich. Find your municipality in the sources below, or on our [area pages](/areas/), and check before you cut.

In Sooke, we could not confirm a private-land tree bylaw from the District's website, so ask the District before you remove a large tree. Most of Sooke's tree canopy is on private land, and the District publishes tree-care guidance for owners.
This is general information, not legal advice. The municipality decides what needs a permit.
Topping (cutting the top off a tree) leads to weak regrowth and decay. Proper reduction pruning keeps trees healthier and safer.
Need pruning, a removal or storm cleanup? See [tree and vegetation management](/services/tree-vegetation/) or [get a free quote](/quote/).
Tree bylaws are amended from time to time. Check your municipality's page in the list below before you prune or remove a tree. This guide was prepared in November 2026.
